messages:
ashley: Heads-up — I hacked together a short proposal for per-layer KMS handling + warmstart prioritization for encrypted, sharded safetensors. TL;DR: decrypt a small prefix (first X layers) with a dedicated KMS lease and stream the rest lazily. Thoughts?
rahul: curious how you pick X. workload-dependent?
ashley: yes — default X=4 for chat models (embedding/ln/head-ish layers), tunable per model profile. We can expose as model.metadata.hotstart_prefix_layers.
mei: major concern: KMS call/QPS + key rotation. If many hosts try to hotstart same model, we could flood KMS.
rahul: we can use a short-lived local symmetric wrap key per host (wrap key encrypted with KMS) to amortize calls. host requests wrap-key once, then decrypt layers with local key. cheap and standard.
tim: that still means one KMS request per host per rotation window. What rotation window? minutes? hours?
rahul: plan: 12h rotation default, override at deployment time. for hotstart we can request wrapped-key with TTL=15m when doing canary/autoscale to avoid stale keys.
jordan: question about correctness: some layers may be in different shards stored across nodes — how do we avoid partial decrypt leading to inconsistent KV cache indices?
ashley: good point. proposal: prefix layers are chosen such that they map to contiguous shard ranges where possible. loader will ensure atomic publish of "prefix-ready" flag in metadata after decrypt+verify. downstream runtime will only use prefix-derived activations once flag true.
mei: what about fallback if decrypt fails mid-hotstart (OOM, network)? do we roll back and evict prefix?
ashley: rollback strategy: eviction + lease backoff. loader writes temp state 'prefix_decrypt_failed' and frees wrap-key; serving runtime falls back to slower cold-load fallback (inline decrypt-on-demand). ops alert generated.
rahul: perf probe I ran shows prefix decrypt of 4 layers reduces first-token latency by ~28% for our llama-like benchmark when combined with KV prefix cache. numbers: cold path 650ms -> hotstart prefix 470ms. not perfect but decent.
tim: good numbers. we should also add telemetry: per-model hotstart success, KMS latency histogram, prefix-decrypt CPU secs.
ashley: agreed. also need to add permission model: service accounts for hotstart only have encrypt/decrypt-wrapped-key permissions, not full key management. keep audit logs.
jordan: storage format change? do we need new header entries in safetensors or sidecar manifest?
ashley: prefer sidecar manifest to avoid changing safetensors spec. manifest fields: "hotstart_prefix_layers", "wrap_key_ciphertext", "wrapped_key_kid", "prefix_shard_map". loader will accept both manifest and inline header for backwards compat.
mei: ops question: if many small hosts request wrapped keys simultaneously during a region failover, KMS spike. we should add global pre-warm: cluster-level cache of wrapped-keys for N replicas. infra-bot: scheduled job suggestion: pre-wrap keys for top-10 hot models every 10m.
infra-bot: (bot) flagged: created ticket INF-1623 to add wrapped-key cluster cache + rate limiting.
rahul: implementation sketch: 
```
// on host start
if (!has_local_wrap_key(model)) {
  request_wrapped = kms.wrapKey(master_key)
  store_local_wrap_key(request_wrapped.ciphertext, ttl)
}
decrypt_prefix(local_wrap_key)
publish_prefix_ready()
```
ashley: API surface: model manifest sidecar + loader opts: {hotstart_mode: [off,prefix,full], prefix_layers:int, wrap_key_ttl:int}. Default "prefix" for verified models.
tim: we should run an A/B: prefix=2 vs 4 vs 6 on heavy-throughput hosts to find sweet spot. cheaper prefixes might be better for large models.
jordan: also consider hybrid: prefix layers are the ones with largest activation fanout (embedding, first attention blocks) rather than contiguous layer count. gives better latency per decrypt byte.
mei: love that. need eval harness integration: tie to existing warmup evaller to compute per-layer marginal-latency benefit.
ashley: next actions: write RFC follow-up with manifest fields and loader state machine, add INF ticket for cluster wrapped-key cache, schedule perf sweep (A/B) with evaller. I'll draft RFC in docs channel tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
